name: K-Town Connection
tagline: Your one stop shop for all things Kannapolis
about: Chris Hughes & Ryan Dayvault take you on a journey through their hometown, Kannapolis, N.C.: the latest happenings from Downtown Kannapolis and the whole community, with a little rough talk and old-school humor. Joined by broadcasting legend Chuck "Dr. Dave from Z-100" Irvin and David Steele in Big Dave's Sports Center.

episodes.title: Millbridge Racing, Family & Kellie Baker, CPA
episodes.full_title: Millbridge Racing, Family & Kellie Baker, CPA | EP 87
episodes.summary: Racing roots, family dreams, and a Thanksgiving conversation right here in Kannapolis. Kellie Baker, CPA, of K Baker, CPA firm joins the K-Town Connection to talk Millbridge racing, small business, and building a career that makes room for family.

episodes.title: Concord Legend E.Z. Smith: Cabarrus County Sports Hall of Fame
episodes.full_title: Concord Legend E.Z. Smith: Cabarrus County Sports Hall of Fame | EP 86
episodes.summary: Concord High School coaching legend E.Z. Smith joins K-Town Connection in Kannapolis to talk about the Cabarrus County Sports Hall of Fame, its Class of 2026, and preserving the stories behind our local sports traditions.

episodes.title: Lady Wonder Champions: 25 Years Later with Doug Wilson, Elise Stanback & Betina Brown
episodes.full_title: Lady Wonder Champions: 25 Years Later with Doug Wilson, Elise Stanback & Betina Brown | EP 85
episodes.summary: Coach Doug Wilson, Elise Stanback, and Betina Brown reunite on K-Town Connection to celebrate 25 years since the A.L. Brown Lady Wonders’ 2001 conference tournament championship—a memorable chapter in Kannapolis basketball history.

episodes.title: Dale Earnhardt Called Him “Shaky” | Frankie DeFeo
episodes.full_title: Dale Earnhardt Called Him “Shaky” | Frankie DeFeo | EP 84
episodes.summary: Frankie DeFeo joins K-Town Connection to remember his longtime friend Dale Earnhardt—the Kannapolis legend who affectionately nicknamed him “Shaky.” Through laughter, tears, and personal stories, Frankie shares how a NASCAR fan from New Jersey became part of Dale’s world and found a friendship that changed his life.

episodes.title: Serving Veterans Around Kannapolis: Rich Todaro & PJ Threatt
episodes.full_title: Serving Veterans Around Kannapolis: Rich Todaro & PJ Threatt | EP 83
episodes.summary: Rich Todaro and PJ Threatt join K-Town Connection to share the mission behind Battle-Scarred Outdoors, a nonprofit bringing veterans, active-duty military, and first responders together through outdoor experiences and friendship. It’s a conversation about service, community, and the people around Kannapolis and Cabarrus County helping make a difference.

episodes.title: Kannapolis Sweet Street: Charlie Barber & Rhonda Barber
episodes.full_title: Kannapolis Sweet Street: Charlie Barber & Rhonda Barber | EP 82
episodes.summary: Charlie Barber and Rhonda Barber join the K-Town Connection to share the story behind Sweet Street, the Halloween gathering that brings thousands of children and families to downtown Kannapolis. Through Outside the Lines Ministry, they’re bringing neighbors together and showing what it means to care for a community.

episodes.title: Sam Mayer & Dale Earnhardt's #41 K-2 Tribute Car | Jonny Cannon & CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia
episodes.full_title: Sam Mayer & Dale Earnhardt's #41 K-2 Tribute Car | Jonny Cannon & CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia Ep80
episodes.summary: Jonny Cannon of CARDIACS Sports & Memorabilia is helping bring a piece of Kannapolis racing history back to Charlotte Motor Speedway. In this special trackside episode of K-Town Connection, Sam Mayer’s No. 41 Haas Factory Team Chevrolet wears pink in tribute to K-2, the car Dale Earnhardt drove early in his NASCAR career, with the Dayvault Tune-Up & Brake Service name on its side.

episodes.title: What’s Cooking at Provisions on Main? Kenny Blake & Anna-Claire Blake
episodes.full_title: What’s Cooking at Provisions on Main? Kenny Blake & Anna-Claire Blake | EP 79
episodes.summary: We’re on scene in Kannapolis’ Midway neighborhood for EP 79! Ryan and David sit down with Kenny and Anna-Claire Blake at Provisions on Main Market & Deli to talk about sandwiches, local makers, and their hope to create a place where neighbors gather.

episodes.title: Pizza For Good
episodes.full_title: K-Town Connection Ep. 78: Pizza For Good
episodes.summary: In Episode 78, the K-Town Connection Crew paid a visit to Corner Crust Pizza to learn how they’re using pizza to make a difference in the fight against pediatric cancer.

episodes.title: Hollywood Comes to Kannapolis: Benjamin McGuire & Joanne Hock on the Charles Cannon Doc
episodes.full_title: Hollywood Comes to Kannapolis: Benjamin McGuire & Joanne Hock on the Charles Cannon Doc | EP 76
episodes.summary: Benjamin McGuire — the man who helped get K-Town Connection off the ground from Episode 1 — finally steps in front of the camera, bringing acclaimed Charlotte director Joanne Hock with him.

episodes.title: Hardee’s Biscuits Got Him Inside the Mills: Chad Mitchell’s Untold Story
episodes.full_title: Hardee’s Biscuits Got Him Inside the Mills: Chad Mitchell’s Untold Story | Ep 75
episodes.summary: In Episode 75 of the K-Town Connection, lifelong Kannapolis photographer and artist Chad Mitchell opens his archive of more than 25,000 photographs that document the demolition of Cannon Mills — the place that built this town.

episodes.title: Lu Graham: How One Band Director Changed Generations in Kannapolis
episodes.full_title: Lu Graham: How One Band Director Changed Generations in Kannapolis | EP 74
episodes.summary: Lu Graham spent 32 years building one of North Carolina’s most respected high school band programs — the legendary Big Green Machine at A.L. Brown.

episodes.summary: Happy 4th of July from Kannapolis! The Rough Talk Cousins Chris Hughes & Ryan Dayvault, Chuck “Dr. Dave” Irvin, and David Steele (Big Dave) celebrate Independence Day with a special holiday episode from Historic Dayvault’s Dyno Tune-Up & Brake Service Garage.
